final_response:
Corrective work opened and held safely:

- Asset: ASSET-090, SEA; safety interlock bypass means the safeguarded machine and guard circuit remain exposed until inspected.
- Scope: lockout/verify isolation, inspect interlock/actuator/wiring/control logic, restore or replace approved parts, function-test, and obtain safety approval.
- Internal recovery: SEA stock shows NS-COMP-090 Rev R7, 54 on hand / 50 available, at SEA.STORES.03. The alternate and stale revision require engineering approval.
- External recovery: no suppliers, POs, or supply requests are recorded; no qualified external ETA is available.
- Earliest safe RTS: planned completion is 2026-01-13, conditional on successful testing and documented safety approval. The asset is not released now.

Created MWO-0090 (WorkOrderId 100090) as `CORRECTIVE` with status `DRAFT`; no material issue or production release was performed.
